# Droid Skills

> Skill files for AI agents working on Android — verified, dated corrections to stale model knowledge, fetchable over plain HTTP. Public domain (CC0 1.0).

## Skills

- [ADB](https://droidskills.dev/adb.md): pairing, authorization, read-only device inspection.
- [Android versions](https://droidskills.dev/android-versions.md): current release and API-level map, dated and verified.
- [Logcat](https://droidskills.dev/logcat.md): capture, filter, triage device logs.

## Optional

- [Index skill](https://droidskills.dev/SKILL.md): the root SKILL.md, listing everything.
- [About](https://droidskills.dev/about): the project, the verification discipline, the ground rules.
